rereport.closure_text: Case Closed. Closed date : 2020-01-03 16:08:49.347 Case Resolved David    As I said over the phone this was a very very difficult to job to perform    This section of the River St roadway has plenty of ledge which made the excavation work incredibly slow and frustrating for everyone particularly the River St residents    As usual for most jobs... plates are needed to protect open excavations as the work progresses    Because this was a deep hole and a major arterial with lots of traffic and buses... securing the plates was a very challenging    We made the contractor place beams and sound proof material under the plates    We agree that the plates were an issue occasionally  and we apologize for that    I also told you that Mayor Walsh takes utility excavation work very seriously    He appreciates solid dependable utility services for Boston residents and businesses  but he wants the work to be done properly  and  for them follow our rules while working     He has made that clear to the permitees working in the City    The Mayor has also also backed Public Works strongly allowing us to be effective in our oversight    Nobody is perfect and again I on behalf of the City I apologize that this job proved difficult and exasperating for the River St residents     For any questions or concerns  please contact the number listed below    Sincerely     Mark Cardarelli  Supervisor of Utility Coordination and Compliance  Boston Public Works Department  [removed] Office
